-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.StartNode` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def StartNode.dynamicSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (c : Loc) (cv : Config) (lok si : GoInterfaceOk) (σ : StorState) (hs : HardStateM)
    (csm : ConfStateM) (R : IProp GF) (peers : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (pv : List Peer) (ps : List w64)
    (ctxs : List (List w8)),
    ConfigValid cv →
      cv.Logger' = GoInterface.ok lok →
        cv.Storage' = GoInterface.ok si →
          sint.Z cv.MaxInflightMsgs' < 2 ^ 62 →
            cv.DisableProposalForwarding' = false →
              cv.ReadOnlyOption' = W64 0 →
                cv.DisableConfChangeValidation' = false →
                  cv.MaxCommittedSizePerReady' ≠ W64 0 ∨ cv.MaxSizePerMsg' ≠ W64 0 →
                    cv.AsyncStorageWrites' = false →
                      cv.Applied' = W64 0 →
                        σ.prev = { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 } →
                          σ.ents = [] →
                            uint.Z σ.ss.index' = 0 ∨ σ.ss = σ.prev →
                              σ.pend = [] →
                                HsEmpty hs →
                                  csm.Voters' = [] →
                                    csm.VotersOutgoing' = [] →
                                      csm.Learners' = [] →
                                        csm.LearnersNext' = [] →
                                          csm.AutoLeave' = false →
                                            ps = List.map Peer.ID' pv →
                                              ps ≠ [] →
                                                ps.Nodup →
                                                  ¬W64 0 ∈ ps →
                                                    ↑ps.length ≤ 2 ^ 62 →
                                                      cv.ID' ∈ ps →
                                                        σ.fl = W64 0 →
                                                          σ.hd = W64 0 →

                                                              ∀ Φ,
                                                                isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                                                                    typedPointsto c cv (DFrac.own 1) ∗

                                                                          ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si) σ ∗
                                                                            (∀ Φ ss',
                                                                                ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                    { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents,
                                                                                      ss := ss', pend := σ.pend,
                                                                                      scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                                                                      sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl,
                                                                                      hd := σ.hd } -∗
                                                                                  (∀ hp cs al,
                                                                                      ownStorage (GoInterface.ok si)
                                                                                          { prev := σ.prev,
                                                                                            ents := σ.ents, ss := ss',
                                                                                            pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs,
                                                                                            sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                                                                                            fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd } -∗
                                                                                        R -∗
                                                                                          hsOpt hp hs -∗

                                                                                                al -∗

                                                                                                ((intoVal hp, intoVal cs),
                                                                                                  intoVal

                                                                                            go!"InitialState"
                                                                                            si.v))

                                                                        (R ∗
